aggregation_to_cell: log2(roughness_2lag_m / roughness_m): deviogram scaling exponent between ~1.9 and ~3.8 km
formula: H near 1 = surface locally planar at 2 km (smooth DEM); low H = rugged at short scale
caveats: At 1-2 DEM pixels H is sensitive to the DEM's own smoothing/interpolation (LDEM_16 partly GMT-interpolated; ETOPO 60s merges sources of differing native resolution): MIXES terrain and product resolution.
